parameters.name: AssetApi
parameters.description: The API of the protected asset to fuzzy match.

parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description:
Instance ID of the WAF instance.

> You can call the [DescribeInstance](~~433756~~) operation to query instance ID of the current WAF instance.

parameters.name: MaxResults
parameters.description: The number of entries per page in a paged query. Valid values: 1 to 500. Default value: 500.

parameters.name: NextToken
parameters.description: The pagination token (Token) for the next page. Set this parameter to the value of **NextToken** returned in the previous API call. Leave this parameter empty for the first page.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region where the WAF instance is deployed. Valid values:

- **cn-hangzhou**: the Chinese mainland.

- **ap-southeast-1**: outside the Chinese mainland.

parameters.name: Resource
parameters.description: The name of the protected object or protected object group to fuzzy match.

parameters.name: ResourceManagerResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud resource group.

parameters.name: ResourceType
parameters.description:
The type of the protected resource. Valid values:
- **single**: protected object.
- **asset**: protected asset.
- **group**: protected object group.

parameters.name: TemplateId
parameters.description: The ID of the protection template.
